Imagine scientists discover something moving beneath the ocean…
Something bigger than any animal ever seen.
Deep-sea sensors detect a massive shape moving in complete darkness.
At first, they blame the equipment.
Then it moves again.
It's over three kilometers long.
And it's heading toward the surface.
Ships begin disappearing from the area.
Sonar detects a massive shape beneath the waves.
Then every sensor suddenly goes silent.
Whatever is down there…
It knows it's being watched.
A research vessel spots a shadow beneath the water.
The ocean begins to rise around the ship.
A helicopter rushes overhead, searching the darkness with its spotlight.
Then the pilot notices something strange.
The water beneath him is glowing.
The helicopter descends, sweeping its spotlight across the waves.
Then…
Two enormous eyes open beneath the ocean.
They glow through the darkness.
The pilot freezes.
The eyes slowly turn toward the helicopter.
And deep below the surface…
Something begins to rise.
